translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Jesús uva-e-saila-sunnadid
“Ani an uva-e-saila-sunnadyobid, an-Babdi agi-arbaedyobmogad.
An-dub-gigwengi sanmaksulile, siklegoed. Ar an-dub-gigwengi sanmakerdi, nue nudakleged, adi bur-bule sanmakegar.
Ar bemar bato gwage-nudakles bukmalad, an gaya-burba sunmaksadgi.
Angi be akamar, an bemargi akamarmogoed. Ar igi uva-dubmar e-sailagi akanaisulile, geg wargwen sanmake, ar bemar ambamodo, bemar angi akanaisulile, bemar geg an-Babga ibmar-nuegan imaked.

“Ani an uva-e-saila-sunnadid, bemar e-dubgii gumalad. Ar dule angi akanaile, degine, an egi akanaimogale, we-a-dule ibmar-nuegan imakerbad. Ar bemar angi ollormalale, gege be ibmar-nuegan Babga imakmalad.
Ar angi dule akanaisulile, melledoed, igi uva-dub-giagan miled-daedyob. We-uva-dub-giagan dingudoed, geb degi dulemar wemaloed, geb degine soogi midmaloed ogumakegar.
“Ar bemar angi akanaile, degine, an-gaya-burba an-bemarga-sogsadba be damalale, ar bemar ibu Babse egisbimala, bela bemarga guoed.
Ar agi an-Bab-nug odummoleged, bemar gatik ibmar-nuegan-imakedba. Geb degine, bemar an-sapingan-sunnadga gumaloed.
Ar igi Bab an-sabgusa, deyob an bemar-sabgusmogad. An-sabguedgi be akamar.
Ar an-igar-mamaidba bemar daele, an-sabguedgi bemar gudimaloed. Ar igi an-Bab-igar-mamaidba an damoga, degine, e-sabguedgi an akanai-gumogad.
“We-ibmar an bega sogsamalad, adi an-weligwaled-itogedyob bemar wergumarmogagar, degine, adi bemar nue bela-bela weligwar itomarmogagar.
We an-igar an bemarga ukmar: Ar igi an bemar-sabgusmarmoga, deyob na be muchub-muchub sabgumarmosun.
Dule emar-sabgued weba bur dummad sulid, na e-san-burba-dula-gudiid uked e-aimar-ular burgwegar.
Bemar an-aimar gumalad, ar an-ibmar-sogedba be ibmar imakmalar.
Bar bemarse an-maimarye an golosulid, ar mai wichulid ibu e-ibed imaknai. Ar bemarse an-aimarye an gochad, ar bela an-Babgi an itosadi, na bela bemarga odulosmalad.

“Bemar an-sussurmalad, ani an be-susmalad, an be-susmaladi, adi bemar ibmar-nuegan imaknamalagar, degine, bemar-ibmar-saedi degi-sadegu guegar, adi ibu bela Babse an-nuggi be egisbimar-dibe, bemarga ukegar.
We an bemarga sogmarsun, be imakmar: Na muchub-muchub be sabgumar.”
Dulemar-we-napneggi-bukmalad istar be-dakmaloed
Jesús na e-sapinganga sogdebar: “Ar we-napneggi-dulemar-bukwad istar be-dakmalale, be insamalo, bemar-idu bato istar an-daksamarmogad.

Ar bemar dulemar-we-napnegginedyob damalana, we-napneggi-dulemar-bukwad be-sabgumaloenad. Ar emigindi bemar we-napnegginedsursoggu, a-ular we-napneggi-dulemar-bukwad istar be-dakmalad. Ar dulemar-we-napneg-naid-bukmalad-abargi an be-susmalad.

Be insamalo, an bemarga sogsamalad: Dule-mai e-ibedba geg dummad guye. Ar dulemar an-baregichamarsoggu, dulemar, bemar-bareginmarmogoed, ar degine, ar abar an-ibmar-sogsadba nanasmarsoggu, abar bemar-ibmar-sogedba nanamarmogoed.
Ar bemar-anba-naid-ular, weyob bemar-imakmaloed, ar ade dule-an-barmialid-aku-dakedba deyob bemar-imakmaloed.
“Ar we-napnegse an nonisulina, an wemarga sunmaksasulina, wemar iskued niksulinad, ar emigindi geg we sogmalad: ‘Anmar iskued surye.’
Ar dule istar an-dakele, istar an-Bab dakbalid.
Ar ibmar-dakledisulid emar-abargi dule-gwen-imakdisulid an imaksasurmogana, adi iskued niksurmalando. Ar emigindi ibmar daksamalad, istar an-daksamalad, degine, istar an-Bab-daksamarbalid.
Ar weyob degi-gusadi, adi emar-igar-maidgi narmakar-naidba guegalad. Bab-Dummad-Garda sognaid:
“Ar dule Gwage-Armaked, an-Bab-nuggi an barmidagoed. A-dule, Burba-Nued-Napiragwad. A bemarse nonikile, a angi sunmaknonikoed.
Ar bemar angi sunmakmarmogoed, ar bemar gebe an-arbaded-onoded-akar be anba gudimalad-ular.”
